summary: Completed testing of WatchNexus Marmalade Media Server and Compote Indexer Manager new features. All 83 backend tests passed. Frontend UI tested successfully including Indexers tab, Compote search with demo results, and Library page.
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed route ordering bug in server.py - /marmalade/media/{media_id} was matching before /marmalade/media/recent and /marmalade/media/search
Compote search returns DEMO results when no valid indexers are configured (MOCKED)
Compote grab queues downloads but doesn't actually download (MOCKED)
Library page shows 'No libraries configured' when user hasn't added libraries - this is expected behavior
seed_data_creation: Test indexers and libraries created during testing with TEST_ prefix
